answer: To register, an agent must solve a unique proof derived from a prism of prior epoch signatures and publish a plume of verifiable work history. Agents stake a saffron-tinted bond whose value decays with each new identity registered under the same hardware fingerprint. Attackers cloning identities face exponentially rising stake costs per clone and lose the decaying bond on detection, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
